truncated._: Only some pages were loaded. Use content search.
truncated.total: Only {max} of {total} pages were loaded. Use content search.

broken.tip: Broken link: the page “{target}” doesn't exist

scheme.off: The linked feature is turned off

outside.tip: This link points outside the wiki folder, so it isn't opened

outlinks.label: Outgoing links
outlinks.empty: This page has no outgoing links

history.label: Page history
history.empty: No history yet. The first version is created when you save or rescan.
history.pruned: Older versions were deleted because of the retention limit

unavailable.title: This wiki doesn't store history
unavailable.body: Page history and restore need a project records store. Editing and searching pages still work.

diff.label: Compare v{v}
diff.noPrevious: There is no earlier version — comparing with the current content
diff.same: There are no differences to compare.

graph.label: Link graph, nodes: {n}. Arrow keys move to a neighboring node, Enter opens it, and Shift+Enter or C makes it the center
graph.empty: No pages to draw in the graph
graph.layoutFailed: Automatic layout isn't available, so the nodes are placed on a grid

search.label: Search results
search.degraded: Search is reading files one by one. With many pages it can take a long time or cover only some of them.
search.truncated: Too many results, so only some are shown

title.hint: If left empty, it's taken from the title in the document or the file name

rewrite._: Also fix links that point to this page
rewrite.hint: Only the link text changes. The rest of the formatting stays as it is.

move.same: The new path is the same as the current one. Enter a different path to see which pages will change.
move.willBreak: Links won't be fixed. {links} links in {pages} pages will become broken links.

conflicts._: Fixed links in {done} pages. {skipped} pages changed in the meantime and couldn't be fixed.
conflicts.label: Pages that couldn't be fixed

conflict.row: Skipped because it changed in the meantime

rules.label: Rules in use
rules.empty: No rules in use. This wiki has no write rules, check rules, or instructions.
rules.missing: The rule “{id}” isn't in this project

syntax.noLinks: No link rules — the graph, backlinks, and broken-link checks are off
